metadataRaw.title: How to Keep Strong After 55
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows simple, straightforward exercises to help you stay active, strong and fit after 55 years young.

These exercises will focus on improving strength and flexibility throughout the whole body (including the legs, core, and back). Make sure to go through them all and use what works best for you.

Watch now and keep strong after 55!
